summary: Isabella Bank Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement relating to an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $30 million of common stock through agent Piper Sandler. Sales will be made at prevailing market prices with a 3% commission; no escrow or trust arrangement exists. This is a routine shelf takedown for capital raising, not a special situation. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes including the Grand River acquisition. No special-situation triggers apply.
